model.name: Add-folder/add-diagram is MVC-live in the tree + broadcast cross-client so EVERY client re-renders (a passive 2nd client, not the actor)
model.description: When a user adds a folder or a diagram under a diagram, the create MUST (1) create the unit, (2) MVC-live add it to the TREE VIEW with NO reload, and (3) BROADCAST a cross-client ws event so EVERY connected client re-renders — not just the acting one. Tron's words: 'make sure that when i add folder or add diagram under diagram it not only creates diagram and folder but mvc live adds it to the tree view and casts it as cross client ws event so all clients rerender.' Ranks with the live-MVC failure Tron reported (current-task change: data changed but view only updated after RELOAD, next slot unchanged, gate GREEN / device NO) — same family, likely same root. The ACs are the PROPERTY not the mechanism, and AC-c is the one our gates keep missing: the ACTING client updating ITSELF locally is INADMISSIBLE as proof — the property is a SECOND, PASSIVE client updating from the broadcast ALONE.

model.metaFinding: ★ OUR GATES KEEP PASSING ON A LOCAL/SELF EMIT (PO): the ACTING client updating ITSELF is INADMISSIBLE as proof of 'every client re-renders' — the property is a SECOND, PASSIVE client updating from the BROADCAST ALONE. Same class as R40.57 (cross-view AGREEMENT on the rendered artifact, consumer-vs-consumer not artifact-vs-model) and the live-MVC failure Tron just saw (gate GREEN, device NO — the gate proved a local emit, not a cross-client broadcast). The two-real-clients gate + required-local-emit-RED-stub is the only admissible proof. [[a-local-emit-is-not-a-cross-client-broadcast]] [[the-passive-second-client-is-the-proof-not-the-actor]]
model.satisfactionStatus: UNVERIFIED (property specified; two-client @390 gate + local-emit RED stub unbuilt; live-MVC failure open — honest third state).
model.crossRefNote: Same live-MVC / one-view-bus family as R37.12 (ViewBus) + R40.57 (cross-view agreement, dynamic-post-broadcast, consumer-vs-consumer). Ranks with the open live-MVC failure (current-task change reload-only). Rides R40.54 failable-AC family. The one-bus broadcast path is R37.12's ViewBus/UNIT_CHANGED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: add-folder AND add-diagram (under a diagram) CREATE the unit AND the TREE VIEW shows it LIVE, with NO reload. Both actions, both surfaces (folder + diagram). The new node appears in the tree without a page refresh.

gateRef.assertion: after add-folder/add-diagram the new node is in the tree view with no reload

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: create requires a reload to show the node -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The create is BROADCAST as a CROSS-CLIENT ws event (one bus, the R37.12 ViewBus/UNIT_CHANGED path) — not a local-only DOM insert on the acting client.

gateRef.assertion: the add emits a cross-client ws event on the one bus (server broadcast to all subscribers)

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: local-only insert with no ws broadcast -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: ★ THE HARD PROPERTY (PO, the one our gates keep missing): EVERY connected client re-renders — proven by a SECOND, PASSIVE client updating from the BROADCAST ALONE. The ACTING client updating ITSELF locally is INADMISSIBLE as proof (a local emit passes a naive gate while a second client never gets it — exactly the live-MVC failure Tron saw). The gate MUST assert: with TWO real clients connected, client-A adds the folder/diagram and client-B (which took NO action) shows the new node from the ws broadcast — no reload, no local action on B. No gate may pass on a local/self emit.

gateRef.assertion: a SECOND passive client (took no action) re-renders the new node from the broadcast alone; acting-client-self-update is NOT accepted as proof

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: REQUIRED RED STUB: a build where only the ACTING client updates (local emit, no real cross-client broadcast) -> the two-client gate goes RED (the passive client shows nothing)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Asserted on TRON'S surface @390, POST-BROADCAST (after the live event on the passive client), NEVER on initial load. An initial-load check would false-pass (the node is there on fetch); the defect is only visible after a LIVE add on a second client. The state-under-test (post-broadcast, second client, no reload) IS part of the assertion.

gateRef.assertion: the @390 assertion is taken on the passive client AFTER the live broadcast, not on initial load

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: assert on initial-load only -> the local-emit stub would false-pass -> that is itself the failure
